title: रामस्य वनगमनम् – Rama's Journey to the Forest
text: रामः राज्यात् वनं गच्छति। सीता च लक्ष्मणः च तेन सह गच्छतः। मार्गे ते नदीं तरन्ति। वने ते वृक्षान् पश्यन्ति। रामः सीतायै पुष्पाणि ददाति। लक्ष्मणः फलानि आहरति। ते सुखेन वसन्ति।
translation: Rama goes from the kingdom to the forest. Sita and Lakshmana also go with him. On the way they cross a river. In the forest they see trees. Rama gives flowers to Sita. Lakshmana brings fruits. They live happily.
composition_prompt: Write a short paragraph (3-5 sentences) describing a journey you have taken or would like to take. Use vocabulary related to travel, nature, and people.

title: विद्यालयस्य दिनचर्या – A Day at School
text: प्रातः ८ वादने विद्यार्थिनः विद्यालयं गच्छन्ति। तत्र ते गुरुभ्यः नमन्ति। प्रथमं पाठं संस्कृतस्य भवति। ते पुस्तकानि पठन्ति। ततो गणितपाठः भवति। मध्याह्ने ते भोजनं कुर्वन्ति। अपराह्णे ते क्रीडनं कुर्वन्ति। सायं ४ वादने गृहं प्रत्यागच्छन्ति।
translation: At 8 o'clock in the morning the students go to school. There they bow to the teachers. The first lesson is of Sanskrit. They read books. Then there is a math lesson. At noon they eat food. In the afternoon they play. At 4 pm they return home.
composition_prompt: Write a short paragraph (3-5 sentences) describing your daily routine. Include times, activities, and people you meet.

title: उद्याने क्रीडा – Play in the Garden
text: बालकाः उद्याने क्रीडन्ति। तत्र वृक्षाः सन्ति। पक्षिणः गायन्ति। बालकाः फलानि खादन्ति। एकः बालकः सिंहासने उपविशति। सः राजा भवति। अन्ये बालकाः सेवकाः भवन्ति। ते सर्वे आनन्देन क्रीडन्ति। सूर्यः अस्तं गच्छति, तदा ते गृहं गच्छन्ति।
translation: The boys play in the garden. There are trees there. Birds sing. The boys eat fruits. One boy sits on a throne. He becomes the king. The other boys become servants. They all play happily. The sun sets, then they go home.
composition_prompt: Write a short paragraph (3-5 sentences) describing a game you played with friends. Mention where, with whom, and what happened.
